description: Every field type the generator implements is documented in the data-generation reference.
cmd: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const src=fs.readFileSync('scripts/datagen.mjs','utf8');const block=src.slice(src.indexOf('const GENERATORS'),src.indexOf('// Boundary/adversarial'));const types=[...block.matchAll(/^  ([a-z_]+): \(/gm)].map(m=>m[1]);const doc=fs.readFileSync('references/data-generation.md','utf8');const missing=types.filter(t=>!doc.includes('\`'+t+'\`'));if(missing.length){console.error('undocumented types: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('documented '+types.length+' types')"
provenance: a field type nobody can find is a field type nobody uses
